name: set-cookie-check
title: Set-Cookie Check
description: Set-Cookie checker that reads back who gets each cookie, over what, cross-site or not and for how long (after the 400-day cap), flagging SameSite=None or Partitioned without Secure, broken __Host-/__Secure- prefixes, wide Domain, missing HttpOnly and size limits.

meta.summary: Reads back what the browser will really do with each Set-Cookie and flags attributes that get it rejected or exposed.
meta.server: Set cookie attributes in server code and test them in real browsers; this only lints the header text.
catches: A Domain that shares a session cookie with every subdomain
Expires and Max-Age that disagree, and lifetimes past the 400-day cap
limits: Follows RFC 6265bis (a draft) and CHIPS; individual browsers may differ
Checks header text, not what your server actually sends
Session-cookie detection uses a name pattern (sessionPattern)
a11y: Visible <label> on the textarea; aria-invalid and a role=status issue count
Each cookie is a section with an aria-label
Fix buttons have aria-labels naming the action and cookie; focus moves to the next fix after one is applied

rules.note: Confirmed in the editor's draft: lifetime limit SHOULD NOT exceed 400 days, name+value over 4096 octets is ignored, and the __Host-/__Secure- prefix requirements. CHIPS (Partitioned) not re-checked. It is a draft; check for changes.
